title: Antlered Sorcerer by the Sea
description: A robed figure with large antlers stands on a grassy cliff overlooking a turbulent ocean, arms outstretched toward a massive swirling cosmic vortex of pink, purple, and orange in the sky. In the foreground, a brown horse stands behind a wooden fence near purple tulips, with a small reflective pond on the grass.
prompt: A mysterious robed silhouette with large branching antlers stands on a green cliff overlooking a stormy blue ocean with white waves. The figure has arms outstretched toward a giant swirling cosmic vortex in the sky filled with stars and vibrant swirls of pink, purple, orange and teal. In the foreground, a brown horse stands behind a rustic wooden fence beside a field of blooming purple tulips, with a small dark pond reflecting the sky. Surreal fantasy scene.
